sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in FIR/Case Crime No.250 of 2024 under sections 323, 328,
376, 313, 386, 506 IPC, P.S. Cantt. District Ayodhya/Faizabad.

3. In terms of the FIR lodged, it was alleged that the victim had met the applicant through social media around two years ago and on the pretext of getting a job, something was administered to her and rape was also committed.
It was also stated that the applicant had promised to marry her.
In the statement under section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim admitted her friendship with the applicant through social media and the version was reiterated.
Similar version was given under section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim has refused to undergo medical examination.
Naushad Pasa vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

sentences.text: Considering the fact that the entire case is premised on forming of physical relations over a span of two years on the alleged false pretext of marriage and the refusal of the victim to undergo medical examination entitles the applicant to be enlarged on bail
, as such, the applicant who is in custody since 06.08.2024 and has no criminal history is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Naushad Pasa be released on bail in aforesaid FIR/Case Crime Number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 4.10.2024 VNP/-
 
Naushad Pasa vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
